author: Porkyyy
body:
I'm sure that everyone hates getting spawn killed right after you die in One In The Chamber (Avicade). So, I think that it would be a good idea to make an "invincibility time" right after you spawn, for 2-5 seconds, which will prevent you dying right after you spawn, causing you to be out of the game so early. 
Also, this would prevent camping. I see that there are a lot people camping in spots where many players spawn. They wait there for the whole time, killing people who spawn, and if they are lucky, they may even be able to snag a 3rd place in the end, although they do not necessarily deserve it.
Thank you.
-Porky
